summary: This is a Git configuration snippet that intercepts any HTTPS URLs pointing to github.com and automatically replaces them with SSH URLs using git@github.com instead. This allows you to use SSH authentication (which is often more secure and doesn't require storing passwords) without having to manually type SSH URLs everywhere.

explanations.1: This line starts a URL rewrite rule that applies to any URL starting with 'git@github.com' — think of it as a pattern matcher.
explanations.2: This tells Git: whenever you see an HTTPS URL starting with 'https://github.com/', swap it out and use the git@github.com version instead.
